title: Affine canonical-map basic opens and homogeneous fractions
statement: Let h:Z→S be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], L an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], A a graded quasi-coherent algebra [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], psi a relative graded line map [def-trf-relative-graded-line-map], and r its canonical map to relative Proj [def-nagata-relative-proj]. Fix an affine V in S, put T=h^{-1}(V), M=h|_T^*L, and let B_n be the underlying additive subgroup of A(V)_n. Suppose rho:T→Proj(B) lifts r|_T through the identity-grading isomorphism and the relative-Proj chart. Let phi:B→Gamma_*(T,M) [def-sc-invertible-section-ring] be a graded map normalized on every homogeneous a of degree n by the degree-n inclusion of psi evaluated on T. Assume its positive-degree nonvanishing loci [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] cover T. Then rho^{-1}D_+(a) equals the nonvanishing locus of phi(a), and on this open rho^#(b/a^q) times phi(a)^q equals phi(b), for every positive-degree homogeneous a and homogeneous b of degree q deg(a), including q=0. No immersion or quasi-compactness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01O9 (lemma-invertible-map-into-relative-proj), characterization (3), affine restriction; Tag 01NK (lemma-invertible-map-into-proj), canonical homogeneous-fraction construction.

proof.text: Trivialize the pulled-back line on an open cover. Express the normalized evaluations in the frame powers. Their unit and multiplication equations give a ring map alpha to functions. The assumed positive nonvanishing cover makes the image of the irrelevant ideal the unit ideal: at every point one of the coefficients has unit germ. The defining IsCanonicalMap equation identifies the relative morphism with fromOfGlobalSections(alpha). Cancel the relative-Proj chart open immersion and transport the identity grading isomorphism to identify the supplied lift rho. The ordinary Proj inverse-image formula identifies rho inverse-image D_+(a) with the basic open of alpha(a); in a frame this is precisely the nonvanishing locus of phi(a). These set equalities glue.

source.place: Tag 01O9 (lemma-invertible-map-into-relative-proj), characterization (3), affine restriction; Tag 01NK (lemma-invertible-map-into-proj), canonical homogeneous-fraction construction.

proof.text: On the same line-trivializing cover, the map on the homogeneous fraction b/a^n is alpha(b)/alpha(a)^n. Multiply by the frame expression of phi(a)^n. Tensor-power coherence and the assumed normalization on homogeneous elements give the asserted section identity, including n=0. Sheaf separatedness glues it over the preimage of D_+(a). Empty charts are allowed, as are arbitrary degree-zero algebras and generators in arbitrary positive degrees.

theorem RelativeGradedLineMap.affine_chart_formulas
    {Z S : Scheme.{u}} {h : Z ⟶ S} {L : Z.Modules} [L.IsInvertible]
    {A : S.GradedAlgebraData} (ψ : RelativeGradedLineMap h A L)
    (r : Z ⟶ A.relProj) (hr : ψ.IsCanonicalMap r)
    (V : S.affineOpens)
    (hM : ((tensorPullback (h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).obj L).IsInvertible) :
    let T := (h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme
    let M := (tensorPullback (h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).obj L
    let 𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup (A.obj V) := fun n ↦ (A.grading V n).toAddSubgroup
    letI : GradedRing 𝒜 := { (inferInstance : GradedRing (A.grading V)) with }
    let γ : A.grading V →+*ᵍ 𝒜 :=
      { toRingHom := RingHom.id _
        map_mem := fun ha ↦ ha }
    ∀ (ρ : T ⟶ Proj 𝒜),
      ρ ≫ Proj.map γ (by
        intro a ha
        exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem γ.toRingHom ha) ≫ A.relProjι V = (h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι ≫ r →
      ∀ (φ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ sectionRingGrade M),
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : A.grading V n),
          φ.toRingHom a = (DirectSum.of (SectionRingComponent M) n)
            (ψ.evaluate (h ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι V (by simp) n a)) →
        (∀ z : T, ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : A.obj V) (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 n),
          0 < n ∧ z ∈ nonvanishingLocus (M.tensorPow n) ((φ.toRingHom a) n)) →
        (∀ (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (a : A.obj V) (_ha : a ∈ 𝒜 d),
          (ρ ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 a : Set T) =
            nonvanishingLocus (M.tensorPow d) ((φ.toRingHom a) d)) ∧
        (∀ (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (a : A.obj V) (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 d),
          ∀ (n : ℕ) (b : A.obj V) (_hb : b ∈ 𝒜 (n • d)),
            (ρ.app (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 a)
              (Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 a (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 ha n b _hb))) •
              (M.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (le_top : ρ ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 a ≤ ⊤)).op
                (((φ.toRingHom a) ^ n) (n • d)) =
              (M.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (le_top : ρ ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 a ≤ ⊤)).op
                ((φ.toRingHom b) (n • d)))
